title: Flow Runtime Loadable Modules
description: Convert flow modules from compile-time Rust crates linked into flow/core into independently compiled WASM extensions, loaded/unloaded at runtime by a VSCode-style JS extension host.
summary: Converted flow modules from compile-time linkage in flow/core into independently compiled WASM extensions with a VSCode-style extension host. Each module (math, text, logic, dictionary) exposes manifest/evaluate/command/activate/deactivate via wasm-bindgen. flow/core evaluates neurons through a JS bridge (setEvalBridge) and accepts host-aggregated catalogue JSON. flow/react FlowExtensionHost loads modules dynamically, aggregates catalogue, and routes evaluation. Flow play gained an Extensions workbench panel with enable/disable toggles and command palette. Build scripts compile all module WASMs; launch.json registers per-module wasm targets. Runtime validator confirms deactivate math removes catalogue kinds and breaks preview, reactivate restores preview 3.
